name: Markdown lint
description: Finds and fixes Markdown formatting problems in notes, never touching Obsidian syntax: inline warnings with a Fix action, safe fixes when you save, and `writer lint` for agents.

memory.note: Nothing is loaded until a note is open; a check runs in a short Rust call a moment after you stop typing.

commands.label: Fix Markdown formatting
commands.description: Fix every lint warning in the note
